title: A reason to keep it
sub: The first film of five in Kept for a reason: why each piece of personal data needs a reason you can say, the six reasons a law allows, asking only for what a reason needs, a yes that means it, and a short check before a new use.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's Night glass: a dark hall of frosted panes, and Oregon in 1986 in the same night light. Green is allowed (the reason that lets HR keep a piece), violet hidden personal data, coral what has no reason or went wrong, cyan who or what something is.
